headline: Final review of Coastal Oaks at 12 Pearl Street and site plan review for a 7,500sf facility at 3 Digital Drive.
summary: The meeting will review the Coastal Oaks project at 12 Pearl Street and a site plan for a 7,500sf facility at 3 Digital Drive. The Quebec Commons extension request at 15 Pearl Street was postponed by the applicant.
items: Review of Westbrook Development Corporation request to extend Quebec Commons approval at 15 Pearl Street to February 19, 2028 (postponed by applicant)
Final review for Coastal Oaks to repurpose the existing mill building at 12 Pearl Street into 20 dwelling units
Review of site plan by T & T Leasing for a 7,500sf facility at 3 Digital Drive to rent units for commercial activities
Discussion of the 2026 Annual Committee Report requested by Mayor LaFountain, due November 18, 2026
plain_text:
City of Biddeford 
Planning Board 
November 4, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
City Hall Council Chambers & Teams 
Planning Board (LIVE) | Meeting-Join | Microsoft Teams 
 
 
 
  
1. Pledge of Allegiance 
2. Declaration of Quorum/Voting Members 
3. Adjustment(s) to Agenda 
 3.a ITEM 7.a. POSTONED BY APPLICANT 
4. Planner's Business 
5. Consent Agenda 
 5.a Approval of Meeting Minutes from October 21, 2026 
6. Unfinished Business 
7. New Business 
 7.a 2026.49 Review of a request by Westbrook Development Corporation to extend their 
approval for Quebec Commons, located at 15 Pearl Street, Lot 1B (Tax Map 71, Lot 2) 
in the MSRD 3 Zone.  The original approval was granted on February 19, 2025, with an 
expiration date of February 19, 2027.  This is an affordable housing project consisting 
of 2 45-unit housing structures.  This project must adhere to the Buy American, Build 
America requirements and has been delayed due to some items needed for the 
project not being available.  The applicant requests a 1-year extension to February 19, 
2028.  THIS ITEM POSTPONED BY APPLICANT 
 7.b 2024.33 Final review for Coastal Oaks to repurpose and renovate the existing mill 
building at 12 Pearl Street (Tax Map 40, Lot 72) in the MSRD-1 Zone.  The proposal is 
to create 20 dwelling units out of this existing structure. 
 7.c 2026.48 Review of Site Plan request by T & T Leasing to construct a 7,500sf facility to 
rent units for commercial activities.  The project is located at 3 Digital Drive (Tax Map 
15, Lot 7-4) in the I-1 zone. The owner / applicant received approval of the site plan 
on May 7, 2025. The approval lapsed and the applicant is looking to get the project 
re-approved. The building is in the final design stages, and the original application
package has been resubmitted for this approval. 
 
 
8. Other Business 
 8.a The Planning Board will discuss the 2026 Annual Committee Report requested by 
Mayor LaFountain.  This report is due to the Mayor by November 18, 2026.  This 
report is being requested of all boards, committees and commissions.  The purpose of 
the report is to better understand each body's accomplishments and challenges of 
the past year and the goals for the next year.  This information will help improve 
coordination among committees, City staff, the City Council and the Mayor, while 
identifying opportunities for additional support. 
9. Adjourn 
 The Board reserves the right to halt official business at 9:30 p.m. Items not heard at 
tonight's meeting shall be rescheduled to the next meeting of the Board. All materials 
pertaining to items on the agenda are available for public review at the Biddeford Planning 
Department, second floor, Biddeford City Hall during normal business hours.
